crm_notes:
Account background: Winfield is a pan-European financial marketplace (trading + reconciliation) expanding into APAC. Longstanding Redwood hosted API customer (since 2023) on pay-as-you-go. Leadership has signaled preference to move to reserved Dedicated capacity for predictable unit economics and to meet residency/SLA needs.

Recent timeline: 
- 2024-10-02: Account created in CRM; initial onboarding with hosted API.
- 2025-11-12: Renewal notification (annual); customer asked about Dedicated pricing and EU-only deployment.
- 2026-01-29: Exec alignment call (FF-2026-01-29-1B9C). CTO: "We need regional parity — EU for data, SG for APAC traffic. Can't accept chat p95 >200ms."
- 2026-02-11: Technical deep dive with SE (Priya) covering batching, KV cache, quantization tradeoffs (FF-2026-02-11-74A2).
- 2026-02-18: Pricing review with procurement; asked for committed baseline + burst buffer.
- 2026-02-20: Sent updated Dedicated proposal (50-GPU EU pool + APAC burst) and Optimize pilot SOW.

Use-case & requirements (from calls/emails): 
- Primary workloads: real-time chat assistant for traders (low latency), nightly bulk embeddings for risk models, reranking for search and trade-doc retrieval, fraud signal generation.
- Latency targets: chat p95 <= 200ms (EU), p95 <= 220ms (APAC) after routing to regional pools.
- Throughput: steady-state embedding job ~600 qps during batch windows; peak concurrent chat sessions ~400.
- Model preference: open models tuned in-house (Llama2 variants), interest in Redwood-verified optimized variants and 8-bit quantization suggestions.
- Routing/fallback: require smart routing by region + automatic fallback to smaller-quantized model under load.
- Cost sensitivity: strong — prefer reserved capacity with predictable unit costs, but want to measure Optimize savings first.
- Compliance: strict EU data residency, SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, KMS integration for key management, 3 year audit log retention requested.

POC / Pilot notes: 
- Optimize pilot (2-week): ran batching/prefix-caching recommendations on their reranking workload — preliminary results show ~18% token cost reduction and 12% latency improvement on p50 for embeddings. Customer wants longer pilot to validate at scale and to get quantization recommendations for 70B model.
- Dedicated ask: 50-GPU reserved pool in EU with autoscale to 70 GPUs for peak windows; separate dedicated pool for APAC (SG) but initially as burst capacity.

Contract & procurement: 
- Renewal target: May 2026 (renewal_date: 2026-05-01).
- Procurement constraints: multi-sig approval from Finance & Security for any Dedicated commit > $200k ARR. Legal requested SOC2 doc and data residency addendum.

Quotes / customer language: 
- CTO: "If Redwood can guarantee regional latency and an EU-only data plane we can go committed."
- Head of Infra: "We need clear fallbacks if Dedicated capacity hits contention; automated routing to hosted variants acceptable but must be transparent in billing."

Next steps (short): 
- Deliver SOC2 package + DPA addendum (action: CSM/Legal).
- Finalize SOW + pricing and get internal sign-off on committed GPUs.
- Schedule 1-week APAC PoC in SG region (SE to coordinate infra).
- Extend Optimize pilot to 30 days and include quantization runbook for Llama2-70B.

Open blockers: budget approval (Q2), legal sign-off on network peering and DPA, customer request for APAC latency SLA language in contract.

Internal notes: prioritize ROI story for Optimize (show predicted savings vs committed cost). Consider cross-sell of Private (VPC) if procurement insists on customer-managed control plane.

Linked artifacts: pricing deck + SOW drafts in Drive; SOC2 snapshot attached. Gmail thread for pricing negotiation: thread-1829012-expand-deploy. Jira tickets for earlier infra escalations: RED-3124 (KV cache eviction bug), RED-3287 (embedding rate-limiter).
